## Blocking finding

### Incomplete prerequisite baseline prevents all qualifying evidence gates

The current repository still lacks the frozen software/governance inputs:

- `fixtures/backend-conformance/corpus.json`
- `scripts/run-backend-conformance.py`
- `scripts/check-backend-conformance.py`
- `spikes/precision/infra-hyperstack/run-approved-backend-conformance.sh`
- `spikes/precision/infra-hyperstack/paid-plan-approvers`

Their all-ref histories are also empty. None of the required managed commits `Implement 0012-...` through `Implement 0018-...` appears in first-parent history.

Related required capabilities remain absent:

- Signed `--approval-request` verification
- `BENCH_BACKEND_CONFORMANCE`
- Durable consumption record implementation
- Dual pre-apply watchdog acknowledgement
- SSH-rule provider reconciliation

Reproduction:

```text
bash spikes/precision/infra-hyperstack/run-approved-backend-conformance.sh --check
# exit 127: No such file or directory

python3 -B scripts/run-backend-conformance.py --help
# exit 2: No such file or directory

python3 -B scripts/check-backend-conformance.py
# exit 2: No such file or directory
```

`docs/evidence/backend-conformance/` has no current or historical tuple. Consequently, there is no CUDA report, two-repetition result, negative control, immutable manifest, teardown status, or provider reconciliation proof.

The allowlist command exits zero but explicitly reports that both prescribed validator paths do not exist and that those criteria cannot pass. `git diff --check` passes.

## Acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| 1. Signed binding, durable claim, watchdogs, one apply | Failed |
| 2. Every case twice on real CUDA | Failed |
| 3. Negative control and canonical validation | Failed |
| 4. Immutable evidence tuple | Failed |
| 5. Teardown and VM/rule reconciliation proof | Failed |
| 6. No prohibited revision changes or second apply | No prohibited implementation changes or second apply observed |
| 7. Offline evidence and repository gates | Failed |

The failures share one root cause: GPU-0001 was started from an incomplete prerequisite baseline. Repairing that baseline inside this evidence-only PRD would violate its allowlist, so no apply or further in-run repair should occur.
